the mechanism of the rescue of stalled and collapsed replication forks and the relationship between DNA repair and homology‐directed recombination in E.coli.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RecA has a role in DNA replication and MgsA has a role both in DNA replication and in DNA repair and homology‐directed recombination.

The main takeaway from our work is that
RecA is not only a key protein in the DNA damage response, but it also plays a crucial role in DNA replication.
the mgsA gene is a good candidate for the identification of new DNA replication inhibitors.
the mgsA recAS25P mutant is a useful genetic tool to dissect the role of RecA in DNA replication and repair in E. coli.
